exposure: Visual estimation of intraoperative blood loss
outcome: Agreement between blood loss estimation methods
cohort: 60 pregnant patients at term undergoing elective caesarean section under spinal anaesthesia.
finding: Visually estimated blood loss was closely related to HemoCue calculated blood loss when the quantity of blood loss was less than 500 ml, but discrepancy increased at 500 ml or more.
cross-section timing: Before and after elective caesarean section
